title: Email: Fw: Might be nothing, but ...

content.text:
Anthony Fenech
Tigers beat writer
Detroit Free Press
(734) 752-9667
Twitter: @anthonyfenech
From: Jahnke, James <jjahnke@freepress.com>
Sent: Monday, July 6, 2015 3:00 PM
To: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Subject: Might be nothing, but ... 
 
Radio making a big deal about a  Kinsler/Iglesias interaction at the end of, I think, Saturday’s game. Might have been Friday’s. Anyway, FSD caught Kinsler seemingly sneering at Iglesias as the team was celebrating the win. There was no context before nor after to know what it was about. But in the clip, he did look like he was mad at him.
Just FYI in case it comes up or you want to bring it up.
